requiredFindings.title: The named binders do not admit the closure or the accepted.by join this amendment assigns to them
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 1 says each closure member is admitted by capture_p2 (head, descriptor and its events), current_record_bindings::bind (clock record and time evidence), and bind_retained_head (root head and its admission), and that a role counts only when bound to the event its accepted.by names, as check_capsule_projection and the event binder already require. capture_p2 loads state.v1 and the publication descriptor, then bind. bind requires phase retained, admits the inline clock.record, and loads descriptor events through current_event_trace::bind_trace. It does not load history or timeEvidence. bind_retained_head loads heads.root body and envelope only and keeps the admission reference. It does not open heads.catalog or heads.revocation. verify_revocation verifies bytes it is given. check_capsule_projection checks head-counter identity, accepted non-null for trusted and revoked roles, and eventHead equal to the last listed event. It does not read accepted.by. publication_events::bind_events is a separate replay, is not called by capture_p2, and does not read accepted.by either. Item 2 steps 3 and 4, item 12, and item 13 still require those loads and that join from the existing binders. Required: name the existing opener for catalog body/envelope/admission, revocation body/envelope/admission, the root admission record, history, and timeEvidence, or state that none exists and X4T-a opens them by the same retained-object load as bind_retained_head. verify_revocation then verifies the revocation bytes that load supplied. Item 2 steps 3 and 4 name those loaders. clock.record stays the inline object admit shapes; item 11 may keep the 47-file ceiling. The accepted.by sentence states only a check a named function performs. If that join is required, item 1 names it as a check X4T-a performs, and items 12 and 13 use the same rule. The capture_p2 event loader remains bind_trace. The r4 note's point 2 follows the corrected item 2. The 32-event list bound, the 40 MiB total, TRUST_VIEW_COST, the ChainBudget row, and the F-absent row stay.

scope: Law X4T r4. RF-1: the named binders do not load catalog, revocation, history, time evidence, or the admission records, and they do not join accepted.by. No product cargo.
